_what: ENDPOINT-MD SENSITIVITY CONTROL — an INSTRUMENT CALIBRATION. It asks whether the E1 readout detects a paralogue difference a primary source says is there. It is NOT a selectivity result and licenses no claim about NR4A3, degradation, efficacy or any therapeutic window.

citation.title: PRT3789 Is a First-in-Human SMARCA2-Selective Degrader That Induces Synthetic Lethality in SMARCA4-Mutated Cancers

reference.selectivity_quote: PRT3789 promoted selective degradation of SMARCA2 while sparing its highly homologous paralog, SMARCA4.
reference.magnitude_not_quotable: The primary publication is not open access, so no DC50 pair or fold window is quoted. Secondary sources report ~40-fold; that number is NOT used anywhere in this panel and must not be cited from here.
reference.pair_mechanism_quote: Represented are the key PPIs between VCB and SMARCA2BD/SMARCA4BD, highlighting the selectivity-inducing hydrogen bonding between Gln1469 of SMARCA2BD and VCB

criterion._what: Whether the endpoint-MD readout (E1 interface-RMSD plateau) detects the paralogue difference that Kofink et al. 2022 measured for ACBI2 between SMARCA2 and SMARCA4.
criterion._what_a_pass_licenses: EXACTLY ONE SENTENCE: 'run identically and without tuning on a known-selective paralogue pair with solved structures on both arms, the ensemble endpoint workflow discriminated them.' It licenses NOTHING about NR4A3, nothing about degradation, efficacy, a therapeutic window or clinical readiness, and it re-scores no landed NR-V04 leg.
criterion._what_a_fail_licenses: The sentence written in advance in selectivity-resolution-options.md §4: the workflow's paralogue-discrimination authority rests on nothing this program has measured, and the NR4A3 selectivity predictions are reported as UNVALIDATED PREDICTIONS. A fail does NOT distinguish 'the readout is blunt' from 'this pair is hard', and must not be reported as though it did.
criterion.unit_of_independence: the co-fold MODEL. Per-leg E1 values are collapsed to model means before the permutation, so velocity replicas cannot inflate the reference set — the same rule as NR-V04 prereg §4a, and the reason B1/B2 were refused in the options paper.
criterion.statistic: mean(E1 | selcal_smarca2) - mean(E1 | selcal_smarca4), model-level means
criterion.test: exact one-sided permutation test over all C(n_a+n_b, n_a) label assignments of the model means, observed arrangement included (nrv04_retro_gate.exact_permutation_p — imported, not re-implemented)
PASS_requires_ALL: p <= 0.05 on the exact one-sided permutation test
the observed statistic is NEGATIVE (SMARCA2 lower/more stable) — the direction the primary source predicts; a significant result in the other direction is WRONG_SIGN, never a pass
the sign survives leave-one-model-out: every single-model refit keeps the same sign (nrv04_retro_gate.leave_one_model_out)
at most 2 technical failures in each arm
at least 4 conforming co-fold models in EACH arm, so the reference set can still reach alpha (C(8,4) = 70, floor 0.0143) after any measured input-fault exclusion
criterion.NULL_when: the design is adequately powered (the membership and reference-set clauses hold) and p > 0.05. This is a REAL negative and is reported as one.
criterion.WRONG_SIGN_when: p <= 0.05 in the opposite direction, judged on the mirrored one-sided test. Reported as a FAIL of the control with the sign stated, because a readout that separates a known pair BACKWARDS is worse than one that cannot separate it.
criterion.INDETERMINATE_when: an arm is underpowered by technical failures, or fewer than 4 conforming models survive in an arm. Not a null — nothing was measured.
criterion.no_interim_analysis: The verdict is emitted only when the panel is complete or an arm is definitively short. Peeking at a partial panel and stopping on a favourable p is the same defect prereg §4f exists to prevent.

statistic_definition: mean(E1 | selcal_smarca2) - mean(E1 | selcal_smarca4), model-level means
reason: NULL — an adequately-powered design (reference set of 462, floor 0.00216, well under alpha) did not detect the difference: p = 0.6385. This is a REAL negative and is reported as one.
